==Description==
'''E-60''' will be the 4th entity you will encounter in [[Section E]] and was one of the Invasive entities present during the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]]. More information about this entity is shown below.

==Mechanics==
<tabber>
|-|Current=
'''Current''':<br>When '''E-60''' spawns, it will begin to rush to the main room at moderate speed, filling the player's screen with static when nearby to warn them to hide immediately, then smash into the door, breaking it down and feigning its disappearance.
After around 4 seconds have passed, or if the door was opened/broke, '''E-60'''  becomes apparent again and proceeds to run at fast speeds while breaking down the door, fully disappearing past the Voidwall.
If a player dies or gets locker sniped by '''E-60''' while it is rushing to the door, it will break a single locker in each room when falling back, this being indicated by [[Oblivion]] marking lockers with an ''X''.

|-|Old=
'''Old''':<br>When '''E-60''' spawns, it will begin to rush to the main room at moderate speeds and emit a low rumbling noise, along with a loud murmur sound when close. 
After '''E-60''' has managed to arrive in the current room, it will proceed to shatter the door and afterwards place itself behind the exit door, where it goes silent, however, '''E-60''' leaves small amounts of static on the player's screen. After four seconds of idling, the entity becomes apparent again while emitting noises and breaks the door down after 3 seconds (2 if in [[Red Rooms]]) and goes backwards at moderate speed, fully disappearing past the Voidwall.
</tabber>

==Strategies & Tips==
* After '''E-60''' hits the door, the player/s has to exit the locker and hide again after two to three seconds before the entity shows up again.
* If an entity breaks the door while '''E-60''' is behind it, it will cause him to immediately backtrack, so if you hear an entity that is able of breaking the door while '''E-60''' is active, do not exit your locker.
* During the [[Red Rooms]], '''E-60''' gives less time to react before and after smashing the door. Thus, the player/s have to enter and exit the locker much more quickly, akin to [[A-60i]].

* [https://youtu.be/ALWnpI7xza0?si=jj9kmGkIeib-DmHt Current Behavior Representation]
* [https://youtu.be/TqbnnePI3eo?si=YDbnZZwaUh9mq8v5 Old Behavior Representation]

==Trivia==
* '''E-60''' has a chance to rush to the main room without its far sound.
** '''E-60''' will start play its close sound from further away, giving you bit more time to react and hide if this happens.
* '''E-60''''s old faces originate from the Roblox Marketplace.
** These were removed from the game due to the user who uploaded them having stolen them.
*** '''E-60''' used to have [[A-60i]]'s old design sprites as a placeholder for the rest of the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]] because of this reason.
* '''E-60''' was one of the two Invasive entities present during the [[Section Executive Invasion Event]], the other being [[E-10]].
* '''E-60''' is the slowest counterpart of [[A-60]] from this game.
